From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC timeline & milestones - Nova Software

Hi Liam / Elena,

Thanks again for the call today -- great to meet the Nova team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have aligned expectations for the POC/trial: 

Success criteria (as discussed)
- Demonstrate <10% latency regression on your 95th percentile inference compared to baseline for typical prompt mix.
- Validate integration with your API gateway and KV cache pattern (see network diagram).
- Show end-to-end cost per 1k tokens projections for your estimated throughput.
- Run evaluation suite on 250 representative prompts with accuracy thresholds > 90% on key label set.

Proposed POC plan / timeline (draft)
- Kickoff: week of Jul 5 -- 1-hour alignment and environment checklist.
- Week 1 (Jul 6-10): Environment setup, account provisioning, and network validation (SRE + infra).
- Week 2 (Jul 13-17): Model onboarding, quantization profile tests, first inference runs.
- Weeks 3-4 (Jul 20-31): Performance tuning, batching/cache experiments, run evals.
- Final readout: Jul 30-31 -- results, recommendations, and next-step proposal.

Owners (proposed)
- Redwood PM / commercial: Marissa Cole (me) -- overall POC owner and success criteria.
- Redwood SE (technical lead): Dev Patel -- infra, model onboarding, and test harness.
- Nova SRE / ML Ops: Liam O'Connor -- network and infra access, latency targets.

Attachments: attached a short POC plan (redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf) and the network diagram you asked for (network-diagram.png).

Next steps
1) Can you confirm the success criteria above and the proposed kickoff week (Jul 5)?
2) Please share the names and contact info for anyone from Nova who will attend weekly check-ins (SRE, ML Ops, product).
3) I’ll send a calendar invitation once we lock kickoff date.

Thanks -- looking forward to working together.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184

- redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf (4 pages, plan + success criteria)
